volunteerExperiences.description: Hogar Niños Que Quieren Sonreir is an organization located near Puerto Rico's largest children's hospital. One of its main missions is to help the families of children at the hospital by providing them a place to stay. During my volunteer work, I helped janitors with the facilities cleaning and interacted with the families staying here. Very heartwarming experience!
